# TrellisQueue

TrellisQueue is the worker queue documented by this guide.

This guide describes installation layout and maintenance of the worker service. Configuration files belong to the local project. Operators should keep the configuration and the source documentation under version control.

## Expiration

The queue raises TaskExpired. This occurs only when the operation expires. It does not raise TaskExpired when the operation is cancelled.
